def _save_cache(cache):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(CACHE_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(CACHE_PATH, "w") as f:
        json.dump(cache, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
        f.write("\n")
